intro.text: An Iriali teenager who helps her mother, a Radiant, run a shop that takes in visitors, some of them from other worlds.

items.text: Dyel and her mother met Hoid a year before the migration of the Iriali, and a strange woman with many rings a month before it.

Just before the migration, three visitors came asking about a mistspren. Dyel feared one was the Herald Nale, come to kill her mother as he had killed her grandfather Ym. Her mother's spren, Uma, cleared it up, and they gave the men a note from Hoid. Then Cusicesh rose from the bay to announce the migration, and Dyel, her mother and Uma entered Shadesmar with the rest of the Iriali.

appearance.text: She has the golden skin and hair of the Iriali, wears her hair long as part of her heritage, and usually wears a bandeau top.

personality.text: She loves and misses her grandfather Ym, and follows the religion of the One because it makes her feel closer to him.
